title: Knowledge base article
description: Write the support article customers and agents need for a change, from the questions they will ask.

inputs.label: Questions and error messages customers will raise
Steps that resolve each case, checked on a test account

tool_actions.description: Publishing the article in the customer help center.

sections.title: Problem
sections.prompt: The situation in the customer's words, including the exact error message.

sections.title: Resolution
sections.prompt: Numbered steps a customer can follow, with what they should see after each.

sections.title: When to contact support
sections.prompt: What to send support when the steps do not work.

checks.verification: Someone followed the steps on a test account and got the expected result.
Screenshots and examples contain synthetic data only.

sources.title: Consortium for Service Innovation, Knowledge-Centered Success (KCS)
